name: Chiseled Enchanting Table (Unofficial 26.3 Port)
description: Unofficial community port of Sacramentix's Chiseled Enchanting Table to Minecraft 26.3 / Fabric. Adds library-driven enchanting, treasure epiphanies, item transformations, book research and upgrade systems, plus optional JEI/REI recipe viewers. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the original author.

custom.chiseled_enchanting_table:port_notes: Unofficial community port to Minecraft 26.3. Feature sync from the 26.1.2 line: dual-track bookshelf progression with mastery resonance, treasure epiphanies with freeze/reroll, configurable XP/material economies, depleted-tome cleansing and blank overwrite, arcane catalyst, crafting/upgrade recipes, expanded advancement progression, yield-aware cost curves, localized UI, and bidirectional JEI/REI transformation recipes. Retains 26.3-specific APIs and data schemas: renderpearl renderer submits, ContextIntProviders/UniformContainerBase loot builders, optional loot-condition holders, hand-rolled payload collection codecs, loot-table condition/modifier schema, and recipe_crafted recipes lists. Active mixins live in chiseled-enchanting-table-port.mixins.json. See CURRENT_BASELINE.md and docs/reports/SYNC_FROM_26_1_2_REPORT.md for adaptation details.
